digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow model configuration and escalation
propositions: model_ladder entries in YAML currently resolve to bare Anthropic model IDs, causing non-Anthropic provider runs to split-brain into Anthropic on entry rung
escalation via models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic names even for Bedrock-configured primaries, causing silent provider switch on context overflow

three batch-runner call sites (production_batch_runner, code_review/batch_runner, DefaultBatchRunner) independently copy model_ladder[0] unresolved, requiring separate wiring rather than single funnel interception
MODEL_LADDER serves dual role as both escalation order and P8 context-window budget via substring match, so class names in the table would break window lookup without explicit decoupling
